program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((colors (remove-duplicates
                  (map third (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells g))))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([color (in-list colors)])
      (let* ((cells (find-color g color))
             (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb))
             (outline
               (append
                 (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r0 c))
                 (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r1 c))
                 (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c0))
                 (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c1)))))
        (paint-cells out outline color)))))
